title: Study on the adsorption properties of Cr(VI), Cu(II) and Cd(II) in acid mine wastewater by coal gangue loaded nano-FeS
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,27864-27881
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04083C, Paper
Open Access

Xuying Guo, Wei Sun, Honglei Fu, Zilong Zhao, Xiaoyue Zhang, Fanbo Meng, Yanrong Dong
This study prepared a novel composite material, coal gangue loaded nano-FeS (nFeS-CG), to remove Cr(VI), Cu(II) and Cd(II) from Acid Mine Wastewater (AMD).
